from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path('/workspace/android-studio-module-presentation')
ARTIFACTS = Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/module-presentation-integration/app-build')
COMMIT = os.environ['KODA_LINK_COMMIT']
assert len(COMMIT) == 40 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in COMMIT)

def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip() == COMMIT
roots = [ROOT / path for path in [
    'crates/android_tools/src/android_tools.rs',
    'crates/android_ui/src/android_ui.rs',
    'crates/zed/src/main.rs',
    'crates/icons/src/icons.rs',
]]
source = [{'path': str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': sha(path)} for path in roots]
for path in roots:
    os.utime(path, None)
for path, record in zip(roots, source):
    assert sha(path) == record['sha256']
(ARTIFACTS / 'build-source-freshness.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'tested_commit': COMMIT,
    'crate_roots': source,
    'source_bytes_unchanged_after_mtime_freshness_recovery': True,
    'helper_sha256': sha(ARTIFACTS / 'cc.rs'),
    'canonical_environment': '/workspace/cloud-environment/env.sh',
    'only_linker_argument_relocation': 'final app output to independently mounted tmpfs',
}, indent=2) + '\n')
command = ['cargo', 'build', '--locked', '-p', 'zed', '--bin', 'koda']
started = time.monotonic()
with (ARTIFACTS / 'app-build-retry.log').open('wb') as log:
    completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
record = {'command': command, 'tested_commit': COMMIT, 'exit_code': completed.returncode,
          'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - started,
          'log_sha256': sha(ARTIFACTS / 'app-build-retry.log')}
(ARTIFACTS / 'app-build-retry-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
for path, binding in zip(roots, source):
    assert sha(path) == binding['sha256']
if completed.returncode:
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)
receipts = sorted(ARTIFACTS.glob('koda-module-presentation-*.json'))
assert len(receipts) == 1, 'Expected exactly one real final-link receipt'
receipt = json.loads(receipts[0].read_text())
original, forwarded = receipt['original_arguments'], receipt['forwarded_arguments']
changes = [index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(original, forwarded)) if before != after]
assert len(original) == len(forwarded) and len(changes) == 1
assert original[changes[0] - 1] == '-o'
assert receipt['exit_code'] == 0
linked = Path(receipt['redirected_output'])
assert Path(receipt['original_output']).resolve() == linked
top_level = Path('/workspace/.cache/zed/target/debug/koda')
assert top_level.resolve() == linked, 'Cargo top-level executable did not resolve to new linked ELF'
with linked.open('rb') as elf:
    assert elf.read(4) == b'\x7fELF'
record.update(executable=str(linked), executable_sha256=sha(linked), executable_bytes=linked.stat().st_size,
              cargo_published_executable=str(top_level), original_linker_output=receipt['original_output'],
              only_final_output_argument_changed=True)
(ARTIFACTS / 'new-app-executable.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(record, indent=2), flush=True)
